purpose: Associate E1 tracking, E3 ROI matching/fusion, E4 backend and independent image motion without causal claims
scope: all 240 E1 frames; detailed ROI analysis for KF31-35 and 23 E3 updates; E4 frozen-map pair events from KF36 onward
texture: Sobel magnitude in grayscale [0,1] on original keyframe ROI, median and p90; cornerMinEigenVal in ROI; absolute values depend on resize and intensity
independent_optical_flow: OpenCV LK from keyframe image to input frame, grid 5px within the original ROI, forward-backward <=1px, normalized cross correlation of 9x9 patches >=0.8; estimates candidate image displacement, not geometric parallax
alignment: E3 events use frame timestamp and reference_kf from E1; E4 backend pose revisions are attached to the frame that created that keyframe; pair seams are fixed-map experiments and only KF36+ are included
separation: E4 signed overlap medians use independent fixed normal per pair; do not compare sign across pairs and do not interpret as metric heights
controls: first vs subsequent update and within-ROI texture quartiles are descriptive comparisons, not independent negative controls; no confirmed normal seam-free ROI
limitations: candidate flow is not ground truth; 2D displacement includes camera rotation and does not measure geometric parallax; unknown scene calibration and matched support; no independent causality
